bio: With its cosy yet elegant interior and charming terrace, the restaurant blends wonderfully into the picture-perfect scene of the estate, which stands against the romantic backdrop of the River Jagst. The light hues of the wood panelling, the tiled stove and pretty fabrics all contribute to the inviting atmosphere. The food draws on international influences, with subtle Asian touches here and there. Dine à la carte or opt for the set menu (omnivore or vegetarian). Alternatively, the pleasant Mühlenscheune serves regional cuisine. There are also lovely guestrooms....
